messages:
mira: CI went red on my PR (#8421). publish-image step failing at push. Started after I reordered some COPYs in the Dockerfile. Error looks like a digest mismatch / blob conflict. Anyone seen 'blob exists with different digest' on push?

alex: ugh. can you paste the failing log lines and the Dockerfile diff? link to CI job?

ci-bot: Job <https://ci.redwood.example.com/builds/8421|redwood-ci/publish-image:#8421> FAILED — step: push-image — exit 1. Logs: /artifacts/8421/publish.log

mira: paste below — small excerpt from the upload error + my Dockerfile change: 

```diff
- COPY --from=builder /app /app
- RUN rm -rf /app/.cache && chown -R redwood:redwood /app
+ COPY --from=builder /artifact /app
+ RUN chown -R redwood:redwood /app && rm -rf /app/.cache
```

publish.log excerpt:
PUT /v2/redwood/serving-image/blobs/uploads/xyz?digest=sha256:abc -> 409 Conflict
Response: {"errors":[{"code":"BLOB_UPLOAD_INVALID","message":"blob exists with different digest","detail":null}]}

sam: that looks like the layer tar changed (order/timestamps) so registry sees same blob name but checksum different — maybe build cache reused a layer with different compression. did you change tar ordering or file mtimes?

jen: also check if registry GC / dedupe ran recently. some registries will dedupe but expect exact gzip bytes. If we rewrote the Dockerfile and cache produced different layer bytes but same layer id, push can fail.

alex: quick triage steps: 1) try a CI rerun with --no-cache / buildx --no-cache 2) if using kaniko, add --digest-file or --enable-archive to force deterministic tar order 3) try building the old Dockerfile commit to confirm regression. can someone trigger a rerun?

mira: triggered a rerun with --no-cache (pushed commit with a CI tweak). also pushed a tiny revert that keeps original COPY order — link: https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/8421/files

sam: i'll watch the rerun. if it still fails i'll pull the raw upload logs from the registry. could be a proxy rewriting chunk headers.

ci-bot: RERUN STARTED — redwood-ci/publish-image:#8421 (no-cache flag)

ci-bot: RERUN COMPLETE — redwood-ci/publish-image:#8421 — SUCCESS. push completed: sha256:abc

mira: awesome, thanks. i'll keep the revert for now and open an infra follow-up to root-cause deterministic layer generation.

alex: sounds good — file a short ticket with the failing logs and steps to reproduce. mark it P2. :thumbsup:

jen: feel free to assign to eng-infra, and we can check registry GC logs / compression settings.

mira: assigning now, thanks everyone.
